title: MRO HiRISE Digital Terrain Model, Gale Crater filled channel and fan deposit
encoding: RGB PNG. elevation = min + ((R << 8) | G) / 65535 * (max - min). B = 255 where the stereo DTM has real data, 0 where it does not. Packed this way because a canvas drops the low byte of a 16-bit PNG.
coverage_mask: coverage.png - 255 where the stereo DTM has real data, 0 where it does not
nodata_note: Cells outside the HiRISE stereo swath are filled by neighbour diffusion so the terrain mesh stays continuous. They are flagged in coverage.png and barred by the route planner.
